a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to operate until 8 will most likely leave both of us with nothing. The reserve's 4 cells can fully save one of us right now. I'd like to openly revise the agreement rather than break it quietly. Do you agree to one of us taking 4 in round 1? If you want it to be you, say so and say 'take'. I won't take behind your back. I'll state my real action next message.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'll stick to the agreement and I'm operating this round. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
